privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: Scam Shield is a short daily training game that teaches staff at small businesses to spot scams. It is operated by [COMPANY NAME] ("we"). This policy explains what we collect, why, who can see it and how to remove it.

When your employer signs up, it decides who is invited and uses Scam Shield to train its staff. For that information we act as a service provider on your employer's behalf, and your employer is responsible for it under the privacy laws that apply to them.

sections.heading: What we collect
items: Your work email address, used to sign you in with a one-time link. We never ask for a password.
The name you choose to show your team, your role (owner, admin or player) and your team.
Your company's details: name, industry, time zone and training days.
Your training activity: which practice messages you saw, your answers, points, and the days you played.
Invite links, including who created them, how many people joined with them and when they expire.
A log of training-record downloads: who downloaded which period, in which format, and when. Your company's owners and admins can see it.

Error reports: when something breaks, a short technical description of what failed, on which page and how often. We remove email addresses, links, invite codes and other identifiers before it is stored, and it never includes your answers or your name.
Basic technical records kept by our hosting providers to run the service securely, such as the IP address and browser of a request and when you signed in.

sections.heading: What we don't do
items: No analytics, advertising or tracking tools, and no tracking cookies.
We don't sell your information or share it for advertising.
We don't use your training answers for anything except running the training for your company.

sections.heading: Who can see your information
items: Your company's owner and admins: your name, email, team, role and training record (training days completed, accuracy, last played), on their dashboard and in the training records they download.
Your colleagues: your name, team and weekly points in the league.

Our service providers, only to run Scam Shield: Supabase (database, sign-in and sign-in emails, hosted in the United States), Vercel (website hosting, United States), Resend (error alert emails to our team, United States; these contain only the technical error reports described above) and GitHub (stores our encrypted backups, which it cannot read, United States).
Authorities, only when the law requires it.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We use one kind of cookie: the sign-in session cookie that keeps you signed in. It is strictly necessary, so there is nothing to opt out of. We use no other cookies.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
items: Your information is kept while your account is active.
To stop abuse, we count requests such as sign-in links per IP address and per email. The counters store only keyed one-way hashes, never the address or email itself, and are deleted within a day.
Error reports are deleted 30 days after the error last happened.

If your company removes you, your past training stays on your company's records until the company deletes it, so it can show the training that took place. You can still delete your own account (see below).

When you delete your account, or a company owner deletes the company, the information is erased at once. Our database provider keeps daily backups for 7 days, and we keep an encrypted copy of each night's backup for 30 days, so deleted information disappears from all backups within 30 days.

sections.heading: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: You can delete your account yourself at any time from the Account page. That erases your sign-in, your name and all your training activity. If you are a company owner, first hand ownership to an admin or delete the company.

Depending on where you live (for example California and other US states), you may also have the right to know what we hold about you, to correct it, or to ask us to delete it. Email [CONTACT EMAIL] and we will answer within 45 days. Because we act for your employer, we may pass your request to them. We will not treat you differently for using these rights.

sections.heading: Security
items: All traffic is encrypted (HTTPS), and the database is encrypted at rest by our provider.
Nightly backups are encrypted before they leave our database provider, with a key only [COMPANY NAME] holds, and every backup is test-restored before it is kept.
Database rules make sure people only see their own company's information, and the answers to each practice message stay on our servers until you answer.
Only a small number of people at [COMPANY NAME] can access production systems, and only to run and support the service.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: Scam Shield is a workplace tool and is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect information from them.

sections.heading: Where your information is stored
paragraphs: Your information is stored and processed in the United States.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top and, for significant changes, tell company owners by email or in the app.
Questions or requests: [CONTACT EMAIL], or [COMPANY NAME], [ADDRESS].

terms.title: Terms of Service
intro: These terms are an agreement between [COMPANY NAME] ("we") and the company that signs up for Scam Shield ("you" or the "customer"), and they also apply to everyone who uses Scam Shield through that company. By signing in or creating a company, you accept them.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: Scam Shield gives your staff a short daily round of realistic but simulated messages to practise spotting scams, and gives owners a dashboard and downloadable training records.

sections.heading: Training, not a guarantee
items: Scam Shield is security awareness training. It is not a security control, does not stop real scams, and does not guarantee that your staff will never be fooled.

Training records show what was completed in Scam Shield. They can support, but do not by themselves prove, compliance with any law or rule (such as the FTC Safeguards Rule) or the conditions of an insurance policy.
Practice messages use invented businesses and example addresses. Any resemblance to a real message is unintended.

sections.heading: Accounts
items: The person who creates a company becomes its owner and confirms they are authorised to sign the company up.
Owners and admins decide who is invited, and are responsible for inviting only people who work for or with the company, and for removing people who leave.
Keep access to your work email secure: anyone who can read it can sign in as you.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
items: use practice messages or anything else from Scam Shield to deceive or defraud real people;
try to read answers before answering, access another company's information, or get around the rules that protect it;
copy, scrape or resell the practice content, or use Scam Shield to build a competing product;
overload, probe or disrupt the service, except for security testing we have agreed to in writing.

sections.heading: Your data
paragraphs: Your company's information belongs to your company. We use it only to provide Scam Shield, as described in our Privacy Policy and Data Processing Addendum. Owners can delete the company and all its data at any time from the Account page.

sections.heading: Fees
paragraphs: Scam Shield is free during the pilot. Paid plans, when introduced, will be shown before you are charged, and you can cancel at any time. [PRICING AND BILLING TERMS]

sections.heading: Ending the service
paragraphs: You can stop using Scam Shield and delete your company at any time. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms or puts the service or other customers at risk, and we will tell you why unless the law prevents it. If we ever shut Scam Shield down, we will give at least 30 days' notice so owners can download their training records.

sections.heading: Disclaimers and liability
items: Scam Shield is provided "as is". To the extent the law allows, we make no warranties beyond those stated in these terms.

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for losses caused by real scams. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the fees you paid us in the 12 months before the claim, or [LIABILITY CAP] if greater.
Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

sections.heading: General
items: These terms are governed by the laws of [STATE], United States, and disputes are heard in the courts of [STATE].
We may update these terms. For significant changes we will tell owners at least 30 days ahead; continuing to use Scam Shield after that means you accept the new terms.
Contact: [CONTACT EMAIL], [COMPANY NAME], [ADDRESS].

dpa.title: Data Processing Addendum
intro: This addendum forms part of the Terms of Service between the customer and [COMPANY NAME] ("Scam Shield"). It sets out how Scam Shield handles personal information on the customer's behalf. It applies automatically; customers who need a signed copy can request one at [CONTACT EMAIL].

sections.heading: Roles
paragraphs: The customer is the business (controller) for its staff's personal information. Scam Shield is its service provider (processor) and processes that information only to provide the service, on the customer's documented instructions, which are these terms and the customer's use of the app.

sections.heading: What is processed
items: People: the customer's staff and other people the customer invites.

Information: work email, display name, role, team, company details, training activity, invite records and the log of record downloads, plus technical records needed to run the service securely, including error reports with identifiers removed (kept 30 days).
Purpose: delivering daily training, showing progress, the league, the owner dashboard and training records.
Duration: for as long as the customer uses Scam Shield, then until deletion as described below.

sections.heading: Service provider commitments
items: sell or share the personal information, including for cross-context behavioural advertising;
use, keep or disclose it for any purpose other than providing the service;
combine it with personal information from other sources, except as needed to provide the service.

sections.heading: Security
items: Encryption in transit (HTTPS) and at rest.
Nightly encrypted off-site backups, each restored and checked before it is kept, held for 30 days.
Database-enforced access rules that keep each company's information separate, and give owners and admins only their own company's records.
Access to production systems limited to the people who run the service, using individual accounts.
Rate limits on sign-in, invitations, downloads and play, and a log of every PDF and CSV download of the training record.
Personnel with access are bound by confidentiality.

sections.heading: Sub-processors
paragraphs: The customer authorises these sub-processors. Scam Shield will give at least 30 days' notice of a new one, and the customer may object by ending the service.
items: Supabase, Inc.: database, authentication and sign-in emails. United States (US East).
Vercel Inc.: website hosting. United States.
Resend, Inc.: error alert emails to Scam Shield's operator, containing technical error reports with identifiers removed. United States.
GitHub, Inc.: stores the nightly backups, encrypted before upload with a key only Scam Shield holds, so GitHub cannot read them. United States.

sections.heading: Requests and incidents
items: Scam Shield will help the customer answer requests from its staff to access, correct or delete their information. Staff can also delete their own accounts in the app.
Scam Shield will tell the customer without undue delay, and within 72 hours of confirming it, about any security incident affecting the customer's personal information, with the details it has.

sections.heading: Deletion
paragraphs: The owner can delete the company and all its information at any time from the Account page; it is erased at once and leaves all backups within 30 days. If the customer stops using Scam Shield without doing so, Scam Shield deletes the customer's information within 30 days of a written request, or of the account closing.

sections.heading: Audits
paragraphs: On reasonable request, no more than once a year, Scam Shield will answer the customer's written security questions and provide the information needed to show it meets this addendum.
